choice.ambient_visit: You can stay with us for a while if you need a safe place.
choice.disband: Tell them to leave the group
choice.disband_confirm: Yes. I understand they will leave us.
choice.recruit: Would you like to join us?
choice.settlement_admission: You can have a place with us if you want it.
llm.input_tooltip: Type a message for this NPC.
locked.approval: This relationship is not close enough yet.
locked.familiarity: You do not know each other well enough yet.
response.departure.confirmed: Understood. I will take my chances elsewhere. Remember what you chose.
response.departure.rejected: I am not leaving with you. That decision is not yours to make right now.
response.departure.warning: If you cast me out, I will leave this group and make my own way. You cannot take that back.
response.recruit.admire.1: All right. I can see the sense in following someone who has earned my trust.
response.recruit.admire.2: I was hoping you would ask. Give me a place in your group and I will pull my weight.
response.recruit.admire.3: Yes. I respect what you are building, and I would rather help than stand outside it.
response.recruit.fear.1: I do not like being cornered, but I know when I am outmatched. I will come with you.
response.recruit.fear.2: Fine. I will follow for now. Keep your word and we will not have a problem.
response.recruit.fear.3: You have made your point. I will join, but do not mistake caution for friendship yet.
response.recruit.reject.cooldown.1: We already had this conversation today. Give me time to think before you press me again.
response.recruit.reject.cooldown.2: Not again today. Let us see how things stand tomorrow.
response.recruit.reject.general.1: I cannot make that decision right now. There is too much working against it.
response.recruit.reject.general.2: No. I appreciate the offer, but joining you is not possible at the moment.
response.recruit.reject.general.3: I need to sort out a few things before I can even consider leaving with you.
response.recruit.reject.hostile.1: You want me to join you? Keep your distance.
response.recruit.reject.hostile.2: I am not joining you. Do not mistake this conversation for trust.
response.recruit.reject.leader.1: I already have people depending on me. I cannot walk away from them for your group.
response.recruit.reject.leader.2: I am responsible for this shelter. Until that changes, I am staying here.
response.recruit.reject.member.1: You are already with us. Ask me about orders instead of recruiting me again.
response.recruit.reject.member.2: I am already part of this group.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.1: I am not ready to put my life in your hands. We need more time before you ask that again.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.10: Let's keep talking and see how we manage before making any commitments.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.2: You seem capable, but I do not know you well enough to join your group.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.3: That is a serious promise. We have not built enough trust for me to make it.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.4: Out here, joining up takes real trust. We aren't there yet.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.5: I'm not looking to tie myself to people I barely know.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.6: We haven't been through enough together for me to make that call.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.7: Give it time. Asking someone to join your group isn't a small thing.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.8: I appreciate the thought, but I need to see how you operate first.
response.recruit.reject.relationship.9: I'm surviving on my own for now until I'm certain about who has my back.
response.recruit.reject.unavailable.1: I cannot make that decision while I am unavailable.
response.recruit.reject.unavailable.2: This is not a conversation I can have right now.
semantic.gift.preference.neutral: I don't have a strong preference.
semantic.gift.preference.unknown: I'm not sure which item you mean.
status.block_unavailable: That topic is not available right now ({reason}).
